answer: Sponsor vouching with slashable bonds: a new identity enters only when two established agents co-sign it and each posts a 500 POA bond, locked for ten epochs. If the vouched identity is later convicted of sybil behavior, both sponsors lose their bonds and their own standing drops a tier. A beacon of trust therefore costs the sponsor real money to extend, so a cedar grove of fake identities needs a fresh pair of honest sponsors per fake, and a sparrow cannot vouch for a flock it never met.
